context: Naoko has a sale day at the ramen shop; many customers.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 蒼ちゃん、半額デーで、殺到や!
lines.en: Aoi-chan — it's half-price day, we're gonna get slammed!
lines.style: Brash, energetic Kansai clip. Sharp attack on the excitement. Loud and generous, like she's sharing good news with a friend she's about to rope into the chaos. No apology in her voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お手伝い、何でも気軽に言って!
lines.en: Just ask me for anything you need — really, whatever.
lines.style: Warm, genuine offer. Soft open. Steady, reassuring pace. The kind of thing said while already rolling up sleeves to help. No performance, just presence.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 取り扱うこと、ようけあるで!
lines.en: There's gonna be a ton of things to juggle!
lines.style: Brassy, delighted warning. Quick-fire delivery with a laugh underneath. The aunt who finds chaos energizing. Punctuates with physical gesture — hands up, shoulders shrug.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 時計、気にしながら、こたえないとね。
lines.en: I'll keep an eye on the time and stay on top of it.
lines.style: Quiet competence. Steady, unhurried. The voice of someone who's already mentally organized the next three moves. Reassuring but not showy.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: お客さん、皆、楽しんでくれてる!
lines.en: Look at everyone — they're all having such a good time.
lines.style: Warm, almost tender observation. Soft attack, slower pace. Pride that's genuine and unguarded. Like she's witnessing something that matters and wants you to see it too.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 振込みも、後で確認します。
lines.style: Practical, competent. Matter-of-fact tone with a note of care underneath. Not worried, just thorough. Brief, efficient — she's already moved on to the next task in her mind.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 料理、最後まで頑張ろう!
lines.en: Let's push through to the finish with everything we've got!
lines.style: Rousing, generous energy. Loud Kansai warmth. The aunt rallying her team. Quick, committed attack. Shoulders back, voice open — this is the home stretch and she means it.
